metadata.question: Was there a decrease in rainfall in Zimbabwe in February 2024 compared to February 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for Feb 2023 and Feb 2024 over Zimbabwe (FAO GAUL country boundary). If empty, fallback to ERA5-LAND Daily Aggregated precipitation (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR).
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for rainfall products. Use inherent masks. Validate coverage via pixel counts.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: If collections empty → C1. If valid pixel count is 0 → C2. If mean is null/NaN/negative → C3. Otherwise compare means; if 2024 < 2023 → A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const zimbabwe = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Zimbabwe'))
      .geometry();
    const start2023 = '2023-02-01';
    const end2023 = '2023-03-01';
    const start2024 = '2024-02-01';
    const end2024 = '2024-03-01';
    const scale = 5000;

    // Helper: Prepare monthly rainfall using specified dataset
    function prepareMonthlyFromCHIRPS(start, end, geom) {
      const ds = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select('precipitation');
      return {
        collection: ds,
        count: ds.size(),
        image: ds.sum().rename('monthly_mm'), // mm already
        dataset: 'CHIRPS'
      };
    }
    function prepareMonthlyFromERA5(start, end, geom) {
      const ds = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select('total_precipitation_sum'); // meters/day summed over day
      // Sum over days (meters), convert to mm
      const img = ds.sum().multiply(1000).rename('monthly_mm');
      return {
        collection: ds,
        count: ds.size(),
        image: img,
        dataset: 'ERA5-LAND'
      };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    function getMonthlyWithFallback(start, end, geom) {
      const primary = prepareMonthlyFromCHIRPS(start, end, geom);
      const sizePrim = primary.count.getInfo();
      if (sizePrim > 0) return { ...primary, size: sizePrim };
      const fallback = prepareMonthlyFromERA5(start, end, geom);
      const sizeFb = fallback.count.getInfo();
      if (sizeFb > 0) return { ...fallback, size: sizeFb };
      return { size: 0, error: 'empty' };
    }

    const feb2023 = getMonthlyWithFallback(start2023, end2023, zimbabwe);
    const feb2024 = getMonthlyWithFallback(start2024, end2024, zimbabwe);

    if (feb2023.size === 0 || feb2024.size === 0) {
      console.log(`Feb 2023 Images: ${feb2023.size || 0}`);
      console.log(`Feb 2024 Images: ${feb2024.size || 0}`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing and Validation
    const totalPixels = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: zimbabwe,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('ones').getInfo();

    function statsForMonth(monthObj, label) {
      const band = 'monthly_mm';
      const validCount = monthObj.image.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: zimbabwe,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band).getInfo();
      const meanVal = monthObj.image.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: zimbabwe,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band).getInfo();
      const coverPct = (validCount && totalPixels) ? (100.0 * validCount / totalPixels) : 0;
      return {
        dataset: monthObj.dataset,
        images: monthObj.size,
        validCount: validCount || 0,
        coverPct: coverPct,
        mean: meanVal
      };
    }

    const s2023 = statsForMonth(feb2023, 'Feb 2023');
    const s2024 = statsForMonth(feb2024, 'Feb 2024');

    // Check C2
    if (s2023.validCount === 0 || s2024.validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Feb 2023 Images: ${s2023.images} (${s2023.dataset})`);
      console.log(`Feb 2024 Images: ${s2024.images} (${s2024.dataset})`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking or processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation and C3 validation
    const invalid2023 = (s2023.mean === null || isNaN(s2023.mean) || s2023.mean < 0);
    const invalid2024 = (s2024.mean === null || isNaN(s2024.mean) || s2024.mean < 0);
    if (invalid2023 || invalid2024) {
      console.log(`Feb 2023 Mean(mm): ${s2023.mean}, Feb 2024 Mean(mm): ${s2024.mean}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN/invalid).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = s2024.mean - s2023.mean;
    const pct = (s2023.mean === 0) ? null : (100.0 * diff / s2023.mean);

    // 5. Output concise evidence (<=20 lines) and final answer
    console.log(`Dataset Feb 2023: ${s2023.dataset} (Images: ${s2023.images})`);
    console.log(`Dataset Feb 2024: ${s2024.dataset} (Images: ${s2024.images})`);
    console.log(`Feb 2023 valid pixels: ${Math.round(s2023.validCount)} / ${Math.round(totalPixels)} (${s2023.coverPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Feb 2024 valid pixels: ${Math.round(s2024.validCount)} / ${Math.round(totalPixels)} (${s2024.coverPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Zimbabwe mean rainfall (mm) Feb 2023: ${s2023.mean.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Zimbabwe mean rainfall (mm) Feb 2024: ${s2024.mean.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Difference (2024-2023): ${diff.toFixed(1)} mm${pct === null ? '' : ` (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)`}`);

    const decreased = diff < 0;
    if (decreased) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
